title: The Final Spark
style: Cinematic live-action video still, gritty, low light, handheld feel.

hero.name: You
hero.look: a young person with messy dark hair, dirt on the face, a worn olive canvas jacket over a grey hoodie, dark jeans, scuffed leather boots, grimy hands

rat.name: The rat
rat.look: a brown sewer rat with glossy black eyes, pink ears and long whiskers

old-man.name: The old man
old-man.look: an old man with swept-back grey hair, round wire glasses and a dark wool coat

shadow.name: The shadow
shadow.look: a towering, thin, smoke-black humanoid shadow with long clawed fingers

music.sewer: dark ambient drone, dripping water, low cello, distant metallic hum, tense, slow, instrumental
music.death: mournful solo piano, sparse, reverb, quiet strings swell, instrumental
music.gate: tense pulsing low strings, ticking percussion, suspense, instrumental
music.fog: eerie music box, airy pads, distant bells, hushed, instrumental
music.shadow: dark cinematic trailer score, deep brass, heartbeat drums, rising choir, instrumental

th.mouth: ปากอุโมงค์

title: 下水道
The sewer
story: 你在下水道里醒来。空气恶臭，黑暗深处有水在滴。
You wake in a sewer. The air stinks. Somewhere in the dark, water drips.
question: 你要做什么？
What will you do?

shot.scene: first-person, kneeling on wet cobbles in a dark brick sewer tunnel; a brown sewer rat sits in front of you beside a battered matchbox
shot.motion: the rat twitches its whiskers and stares at you, water drips

title: बंद सिरा
Dead end
story: आगे बंद दीवार है। फर्श पर कुछ काला और घिनौना पसरा है।
A dead end. Something black and foul is smeared across the floor.
question: तुम क्या करोगे?
What will you do?

shot.scene: first-person, your hand holds a lit match up to a bricked-up dead end; black sludge covers the floor
shot.motion: the match flame flickers, the camera looks down at the sludge

title: El pasadizo
The passage
story: Vuelves al pasadizo. La cloaca sigue hacia la oscuridad.
Back in the passage. The sewer runs on into the dark.
question: Solo queda un camino.
Only one way is left.

shot.scene: first-person, a lit match held out toward a long arched stone sewer passage
shot.motion: slow push forward down the passage, the flame wavers

title: La boue
The sludge
story: Tu touches la boue. La substance dégoûtante te couvre la peau, et tu commences à te sentir gravement malade.
You touch the sludge. The disgusting substance gets all over your skin, and you begin to feel seriously ill.
question: Tu es mort.
You have died.

shot.scene: close-up of your dirty hand touching glowing green sludge on the sewer floor
shot.motion: the fingers sink in, the green glow creeps up the skin, the hand trembles

title: ماء المجاري
Sewer water
story: تصل إلى جزء مغمور من المجاري. الماء قذر.
You reach a flooded stretch. The water is filthy.
question: ماذا ستفعل؟
What will you do?

shot.scene: first-person, wading through ankle-deep filthy sewer water under a stone arch, match in hand
shot.motion: slow wading steps, ripples, the match light dances on the water

title: Fora da água
Out of the water
story: Você sai da água. O rato sai atrás de você, tremendo.
You haul yourself out. The rat climbs out after you, shivering.
question: O que você faz pelo rato?
What do you do about the rat?

shot.scene: you climb out of the sewer water onto a narrow stone ledge, boots dripping; a wet brown rat climbs out beside you
shot.motion: the hero stands, the rat shakes water off its fur and looks up

title: Окопная стопа
Trench foot
story: Ты слишком долго стоял в грязной воде. Окопная стопа. Ноги отказывают, и дальше ты не идёшь.
Too long in the filthy water. Trench foot. Your legs give out, and you go no further.
question: Ты умер.
You have died.

shot.scene: close-up of pale, swollen, wrinkled feet beside a pair of soaked boots in the dark
shot.motion: the light dims, a slow fade toward black

title: 門
The gate
story: 錠のかかった鉄の門が道をふさいでいる。
A locked iron gate blocks the way.
question: どうする？
What will you do?

shot.scene: a rusted iron gate blocks the sewer tunnel, lit by a single match; faint light beyond the bars
shot.motion: the camera approaches the gate, the match flame flutters

story: 錠のかかった鉄の門。ネズミが錠のにおいを嗅いでいる。
A locked iron gate. The rat sniffs at the lock.
錠のかかった鉄の門。ネズミは闇の中から、こちらを見ている。
A locked iron gate. The rat watches from the dark.

title: গেট ভাঙো
Break the gate
story: তুমি গেটে কাঁধ দিয়ে ধাক্কা দাও। গেট নড়ে না।
You throw your shoulder against the gate. It doesn't move.
question: এরপর কী করবে?
What will you do next?

shot.scene: your hands grip the bars of the rusted iron gate and pull hard
shot.motion: the hero shakes the gate, rust falls, it does not give

title: Das Schloss knacken
Pick the lock
story: Du fummelst am Schloss herum. Mit bloßen Fingern ist da nichts zu machen.
You work at the lock. Bare fingers aren't enough.
question: Was machst du als Nächstes?
What will you do next?

shot.scene: close-up of your fingers working a bent wire in the gate's rusted padlock by match light
shot.motion: the fingers twist the wire, the lock does not open

title: 열쇠
The key
story: 벽에 묶인 해골의 손에 열쇠가 걸려 있다.
A key hangs from the hand of a skeleton chained to the wall.
question: 그걸로 무엇을 할 거야?
What will you do with it?

shot.scene: first-person, a match lights a skeleton chained to the sewer wall; an old iron key hangs from its ribs
shot.motion: the hand reaches toward the key, smoke curls from the match

title: Kilidi aç
Unlock
story: Anahtar kilide uyar. Kapının ardında kalın bir sis var.
The key fits. Behind the gate, thick fog.
question: Sisin içine girecek misin?
Will you enter the fog?

shot.scene: the old key turns in the padlock; the gate swings open onto thick white fog
shot.motion: the gate creaks open and fog rolls through

story: Anahtar uyar, ama kapı çarpık duruyor. Ardında kalın bir sis var.
The key fits, but the gate hangs crooked. Behind it, thick fog.
Anahtar kilide uyar. Kapı sessizce açılır. Ardında kalın bir sis var.
The key fits. The gate swings open quietly. Behind it, thick fog.

title: Sương mù
The fog
story: Bạn bước qua cổng vào sương mù. Gần như không thấy gì phía trước.
You step through the gate into the fog. You can barely see ahead.
question: Bạn sẽ làm gì?
What will you do?

shot.scene: a foggy cobblestone street of an old town at dusk; a tall dark house with a closed door looms ahead
shot.motion: slow walk forward through the fog toward the house

story: Bạn bước vào sương mù. Con chuột thò đầu ra từ túi áo.
You step into the fog. The rat peeks out of your pocket.
Con chuột chạy trước vào sương mù, đuôi dựng thẳng.
The rat runs ahead into the fog, tail up.
Bạn bước vào sương mù. Phía sau, không còn tiếng chân chuột.
You step into the fog. Behind you, no sound of rat feet.

title: Brucia la porta
Burn the door
story: Accosti la fiamma alla porta. Il legno vecchio prende fuoco subito.
You hold the flame to the door. The old wood catches at once.
question: Che cosa succede dopo?
What happens next?

shot.scene: first-person, a lit match held to a weathered wooden front door in the fog
shot.motion: the flame catches and creeps up the door

title: Ketuk
Knock
story: Kamu mengetuk pintu. Seorang lelaki tua membuka, lalu menyuruhmu pergi.
You knock. An old man opens the door and sends you away.
question: Apa yang terjadi selanjutnya?
What happens next?

shot.scene: an old man with grey hair and round glasses opens the door and glares out into the fog
shot.motion: the old man leans out and speaks sharply

lines.speaker: old-man
lines.text: Do you know what time it is? Go away. Nobody comes out of that fog.

title: ٹرک
The truck
story: ایک سفید ٹرک گلی میں کھلا کھڑا ہے۔
A white truck stands open in the street.
question: تم کیا کرو گے؟
What will you do?

shot.scene: a white van stands alone with its door open on a foggy cobbled street
shot.motion: the hero walks up to the van, fog drifts

story: ایک سفید ٹرک گلی میں کھلا کھڑا ہے۔ پیچھے دروازہ جل رہا ہے۔
A white truck stands open in the street. Behind you, the door burns.
ایک سفید ٹرک گلی میں کھلا کھڑا ہے۔ بوڑھے نے اپنا دروازہ بند کر لیا ہے۔
A white truck stands open in the street. The old man has shut his door.

title: Dentro
Inside
story: Subes a la camioneta. En la oscuridad de la cabina, algo se mueve.
You climb in. In the dark of the cab, something moves.
question: ¿Qué pasa ahora?
What happens next?

shot.scene: the hero, a young person in a worn olive canvas jacket and hood, climbs into the white van
shot.motion: the hero pulls themself inside, the door swings

title: เดินจากไป
Walk away
story: เจ้าหันหลังให้รถบรรทุกแล้วเดินจากไป แต่เงาตามมา
You turn your back on the truck and walk. The shadow follows.
question: เจ้าจะทำอะไร?
What will you do?

choices.say: เต้นกับเงา

shot.scene: the hero walks away down a foggy cobbled street, a match glowing in one hand
shot.motion: the figure walks away and fades into the fog

title: Densi ya kivuli
Shadow dance
story: Unacheza na kivuli. Taa za mji ziliwashwa ili kukifunga chini; sasa kinataka ziizime.
You dance with the shadow. The town lit its lamps to keep it down; now it wants them out.
question: Kivuli kinakupa nguvu mbili.
The shadow gives you two powers.

shot.scene: a towering shadow creature with long claws stands in white fog over the hero's boots on the cobbles
shot.motion: the hero and the shadow move together in a slow dance

story: Ndani ya gari, kivuli kinakushika mkono. Taa za mji ziliwashwa ili kukifunga; kinataka ziizime.
In the cab the shadow takes your hand. The town lit its lamps to keep it down; it wants them out.
Kivuli kinakufuata barabarani na kucheza nawe. Taa za mji ziliwashwa ili kukifunga; kinataka ziizime.
The shadow follows you down the street and dances. The town lit its lamps to keep it down; it wants them out.

title: புதிய சக்திகள்
New powers
story:
அவற்றை சரியாகப் பயன்படுத்த இன்னும் தெரியவில்லை.

உனக்கு 2 புதிய சக்திகள் உள்ளன:

• ஒளியை விழுங்கு
• நிழல் தையல்

You haven't figured out how to use them properly yet.

You have 2 new powers:

• Consume Light
• Shadow Stitch
question: எந்த சக்தியை ஆராய்வாய்?
Which power will you explore?

shot.scene: the hero's open hand, dark smoke curling from the fingers, in a foggy street
shot.motion: the smoke wraps around the hand and pulses

title: కాంతిని మింగు
Consume Light
story: నువ్వు కాంతిని మింగడానికి ప్రయత్నిస్తావు.
You attempt to use Consume Light.
question: తర్వాత ఏం జరుగుతుంది?
What happens next?

shot.scene: first-person, the hand reaches toward candles on a foggy windowsill; the flames bend toward the palm
shot.motion: the candle flames stretch and pour into the hand

title: सावली शिवणे
Shadow Stitch
story: तू सावली शिवण्याचा प्रयत्न करतोस.
You attempt to use Shadow Stitch.
question: पुढे काय होते?
What happens next?

shot.scene: the hero's shadow on the cobbles stretches and stitches itself to the shadow of a lamppost
shot.motion: black threads pull the shadows together

title: ਸ਼ਹਿਰ ਤਬਾਹ ਕਰੋ
Destroy the town
story: ਤੂੰ ਸਾਰਾ ਸ਼ਹਿਰ ਤਬਾਹ ਕਰ ਦਿੰਦਾ ਹੈਂ। ਇੱਕ-ਇੱਕ ਕਰਕੇ ਹਰ ਬੱਤੀ ਬੁਝ ਜਾਂਦੀ ਹੈ।
You destroy the whole town. One by one, every light goes out.

shot.scene: the old foggy town burning and falling apart, seen from a hill, shadows pouring through the streets
shot.motion: slow push in as buildings collapse into darkness

title: Le rat
The rat
story: Tu poses une croûte par terre. Le rat la ronge, puis te regarde.
You set a crust on the ground. The rat gnaws it, then looks at you.
question: Il trottine déjà vers le portail.
It is already trotting toward the gate.

shot.scene: close-up, a brown sewer rat gnaws a crust on wet cobbles beside a lit match, then looks up at the camera
shot.motion: the rat chews, whiskers twitch, it raises its head

title: За крысой
Follow the rat
story: Крыса бежит вперёд. Ты идёшь на писк в боковую трубу.
The rat runs ahead. You follow its squeaks into a side pipe.
question: Труба узкая и мокрая.
The pipe is narrow and wet.

shot.scene: first-person, a match held toward a low brick side pipe; a brown rat's tail disappears into it
shot.motion: the camera ducks and crawls after the rat, the flame wavers

title: 窄管
The pipe
story: 你挤出窄管，铁门已在身后。雾就在前面。
You squeeze out of the pipe; the iron gate is behind you. Fog lies ahead.
question: 老鼠蹲在管口，看着你。
The rat crouches at the pipe's mouth, watching you.

shot.scene: the hero crawls out of a brick pipe onto a foggy cobbled street; the iron gate stands behind, the rat sits at the pipe's mouth
shot.motion: the hero stands, fog rolls in, the rat watches

title: Am Tier vorbei
Step past the rat
story: Du steigst über das Tier hinweg. Es sieht dir nach, dann ist es fort.
You step over it. It watches you go, then it is gone.
question: Vor dir sperrt ein Tor den Gang.
A gate bars the passage ahead.

shot.scene: first-person, a boot steps over a small brown rat on a narrow ledge; the rat watches, then slips into a drain
shot.motion: the camera walks on, the rat shrinks behind

title: 명찰
The tag
story: 해골 목의 놋쇠 명찰에 '점등원'이라 적혀 있다. 뒷면에는 네 이름.
The skeleton's brass tag reads LAMPLIGHTER. On the back, your name.
question: 열쇠가 그 아래 걸려 있다.
The key hangs beneath it.

shot.scene: close-up by match light, a brass tag on a chain round a chained skeleton's neck, an old iron key beneath it; a thumb turns the tag over
shot.motion: the thumb flips the tag, scratched letters catch the flame

title: El farolero
The lamplighter
story: Te mira las manos. «Hollín de farolero. Tú encendías estas lámparas.»
He studies your hands. "Lamplighter's soot. You lit these lamps."
question: Cierra la puerta despacio.
He closes the door slowly.

shot.scene: an old man with grey hair and round glasses holds a door half open in the fog, studying the hero's soot-black hands
shot.motion: the old man looks from the hands to the face, then slowly shuts the door

lines.speaker: old-man
lines.text: Lamplighter's soot. You lit every lamp in this town, and you locked the dark under it.

title: Les lampes
The lamps
story: Les fenêtres s'éteignent une à une. L'ombre attend ta réponse.
Window after window goes dark. The shadow waits for your answer.
question: Que fais-tu des lampes ?
What do you do with the lamps?

shot.scene: first-person, the hero stands in a foggy square as every window and lamp goes dark one by one; a tall shadow waits at the edge of the light, a rat sits near the boots
shot.motion: slow pan across the darkening windows, the last candle gutters

story: Les fenêtres s'éteignent. Dans un caniveau, le rat te regarde.
The windows go dark. From a gutter the rat watches you.
Les fenêtres s'éteignent. Le rat s'est assis sur ton pied.
The windows go dark. The rat has sat down on your foot.
Les fenêtres s'éteignent. Aucun rat ne vient. Tu es seul.
The windows go dark. No rat comes. You are alone.

title: Os fios
The threads
story: Fios negros puxam as sombras dos postes até os teus pés. A sombra espera.
Black threads pull the lampposts' shadows to your feet. The shadow waits.
question: O que fazes com a cidade?
What do you do with the town?

shot.scene: the hero's shadow on the cobbles stitches itself to a row of lamppost shadows with black threads; the tall shadow waits behind
shot.motion: the threads pull taut, the lamps flicker

story: Os fios negros contornam o rato, que roi a última migalha.
The black threads curl around the rat, gnawing its last crumb.
Os fios negros passam por cima do rato, sentado no teu pé.
The black threads pass over the rat, sitting on your foot.
Nenhum rato à vista. Só os fios e a sombra.
No rat in sight. Only the threads and the shadow.

title: 影を拒む
Refuse the shadow
story: きみはマッチを高く掲げる。影は炎の前で縮み、街の灯が一つずつ戻る。
You hold the match high. The shadow shrinks from the flame, and the town's lights come back one by one.

shot.scene: first-person, a lit match held high in a foggy square; windows and lamps relight one by one as a tall black shadow shrinks back into the cobbles
shot.motion: the flame steadies, light spreads across the windows

title: La luz de la rata
The rat's light
story: Silbas. Un correteo, y la rata arrastra hasta ti un cabo de vela encendido.
You whistle. Small feet, and the rat drags a burning candle stub to you.

shot.scene: a small brown rat drags a burning candle stub across wet cobbles toward the camera in a dark foggy square
shot.motion: the rat hauls the candle, its flame lights the whiskers and the black shadow pulls back

title: Der Laternenanzünder
The lamplighter
story: Du sagst, wer du warst. Die Laternen am Platz glimmen auf, und der Schatten sinkt unter das Pflaster.
You say who you were. The lamps on the square glow, and the shadow sinks back under the cobbles.

shot.scene: a foggy old square at dusk; one by one the gas lamps glow on, a tall black shadow sinks into the cobbles
shot.motion: slow push in as the lamps catch

items.name: Matches
items.note: Every page burns one match. At two or fewer, the options change.
